summary.short: Committee report proposing a fifth paragraph to Art. 20 Quáter of Mexico's General Law on Women's Access to a Life Free of Violence. If enacted, it would sanction non-consensual technological generation or dissemination of intimate sexual images, videos or audio simulating sexual acts of a person.
summary.long: Committee report (dictamen dated 21 October 2025, published in the Gaceta Parlamentaria on 17 February 2026) approving with modifications an initiative to amend the Ley General de Acceso de las Mujeres a una Vida Libre de Violencia. Its single operative article (Único) adds a fifth paragraph to Art. 20 Quáter. The paragraph would sanction any intentional conduct consisting of the total or partial generation, by technological means, of intimate sexual images, videos or audio that simulate sexual acts or pornographic representations of a person, without that person's consent, approval or authorization. It would also sanction the disclosure, distribution, publication or sharing of such material, even if created wholly or partly by those means. No penalty is specified in the text. The comparison table records 'Se mantiene texto vigente' (current text retained) for the proposed Art. 5 definition of generative artificial intelligence and for proposed Art. 20 Septies; the operative decree does not amend either. The decree enters into force the day after publication in the Diario Oficial de la Federación. The file is pending, with the legislative deadline extended to 31 August 2027.

notes: Committee report (dictamen) with a draft decree; registry status pending. Source is OCR of a scanned Gaceta PDF, so quotes may carry OCR line breaks. Internal inconsistency: the title and heading refer to reforming Art. 5 and adding Art. 20 Septies, but the operative decree (Único) only adds a fifth paragraph to Art. 20 Quáter. The comparison table shows 'Se mantiene texto vigente' in the commission column for Art. 5 and Art. 20 Septies. The commission's considerandos SEXTA and SÉPTIMA state that the initiative repeats provisions already in Capítulo IV Ter of this law. Dates in the text: session 29 April 2025, referral 30 April 2025, deadline extended to 31 August 2027, dictamen signed 21 October 2025, Gaceta issue 17 February 2026.
